description: This file defines a question generator agent using a state machine workflow with validation, capable of generating single or multiple questions concurrently, and includes logic for validation and regeneration based on medical and quality criteria.

classes.name: QuestionState
classes.description: State schema for the question generation workflow, defining the data structure used during question creation and validation.

classes.name: QuestionGeneratorAgent
classes.description: Agent class that manages question generation workflow, including graph building, validation, and batch processing.

methods.name: _build_graph
methods.description: Constructs the state graph workflow for question generation, including nodes, edges, and conditional logic.

methods.name: _should_regenerate
methods.description: Determines whether to regenerate a question based on validation results, attempt count, and medical accuracy.

methods.name: generate_single_question
methods.description: Asynchronously generates a single question for a specified chapter and difficulty, returning the question data or None on failure.

methods.name: generate_batch_questions
methods.description: Asynchronously generates multiple questions in batches, managing concurrency and aggregating results.
